title: Chubby marmots join subscription service after sanctuary faces money trouble
summary_full: In a creative twist, a biologist from Colorado turned to popular subscription service to secure funding for crucial marmot research. He shares engaging and family-oriented videos featuring yellow-bellied marmots, motivated by recent federal budget cuts affecting his long-standing project. Operating for over sixty years, this initiative not only raises awareness about marmot populations but has also begun to generate essential financial support for ongoing scientific investigations.
